sentences.en: With people coming in and out of the house.

sentences.en: Michael, you sort of have to go back to the beginning of March when the pandemic and COVID is really bearing down on New York City.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，你得把时间倒回3月初，当时大流行和新冠疫情正狠狠地向纽约市压过来。

sentences.en: Good evening, everyone.

sentences.en: Tonight, we're becoming crushed under a tidal wave of unfathomable numbers.
sentences.zh: 今晚，我们正被海量且难以置信的数字压得喘不过气来。

sentences.en: Queens in New York is the worst infected district in what is now the world's worst infected city and the doctors and nurses don't know what's hit them.
sentences.zh: 纽约的皇后区是目前全球疫情最严重的城市中最严重的地区，医生和护士们甚至不知道到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: It's the epicenter of the crisis.
sentences.zh: 这里是危机的震中。

sentences.en: People come in, they get intubated, they die, the cycle repeats.
sentences.zh: 病人进来，插管，然后死亡，循环往复。

sentences.en: New York City paramedics are no longer taking patients to hospitals unless they have a pulse to ease the strain on overcrowded ERs.
sentences.zh: 纽约市的急救人员不再将患者送往医院，除非他们还有脉搏，以此来缓解过度拥挤的急诊室的压力。

sentences.en: What is becoming quite clear is New York is reaching a tipping point and far sooner than anyone here expected.
sentences.zh: 越来越明显的是，纽约正在迎来一个临界点，而且比这里任何人预期的都要快得多。

sentences.en: And the Cuomo administration said that they were scrambling to free up hospital beds.
sentences.zh: 库默政府当时表示，他们正在手忙脚乱地腾出医院病床。

sentences.en: We have 3,000 ICU beds.
sentences.zh: 我们有3000张重症监护病床。

sentences.zh: 我们可能需要1.8万到

sentences.zh: 他们当时正在考察各种不同的设施。

sentences.zh: 他们当时在考察手术中心，疗养院也是他们考察的地点之一，现在回想起来，这听起来有点疯狂。

sentences.en: But at the time, the Cuomo administration said that they were looking at any type of health care
sentences.zh: 但在当时，库默政府表示他们正在考察任何类型的医疗

sentences.en: facility to just ensure that the sickest patients could receive the best care in hospitals that were predicted to be totally overwhelmed.
sentences.zh: 设施，以确保病情最重的患者能在预计将完全不堪重负的医院里获得最佳治疗。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I can remember vividly those conversations from the governor about hospital capacity.
sentences.zh: 我清晰地记得州长当时关于医院收治能力的那些谈话。

sentences.en: That was the number one priority.
sentences.zh: 那是头等大事。

sentences.en: And I feel like it's at this point that many people outside New York are discovering Governor Andrew Cuomo for the first time.
sentences.zh: 我觉得也是从这个时候起，许多纽约以外的人开始第一次认识安德鲁·库默州长。

sentences.en: But for those of us who have covered him and New York State for years, it felt like this was sort of the moment he was born for.
sentences.zh: 但对于我们这些报道了他和纽约州多年的人来说，这感觉像是他生来就为了迎接的时刻。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He had long run the state as a kind of unilateral force.
sentences.zh: 他长期以来一直以一种单边独断的方式管理这个州。

sentences.en: And I remember talking to him at the time, actually for an episode of The Daily, and he compared himself to a wartime president.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时还采访过他，实际上是为了《每日新闻》的一期节目，他把自己比作战时总统。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: A general with enemies.
sentences.zh: 一个拥有敌人的将军。

sentences.en: We are seeing the enemy on the horizon.
sentences.zh: 我们正在地平线上看到敌人。

sentences.en: And they are approaching very quickly.
sentences.zh: 他们正在迅速逼近。

sentences.en: And in this case, that enemy was the coronavirus, which was suddenly at the gate.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，那个敌人就是突然兵临城下的冠状病毒。

sentences.en: And it really did feel like a lot of people were responding to this style of leadership from him.
sentences.zh: 而且确实让人感觉很多人都在呼应他的这种领导风格。

sentences.en: I remember personally at the time, I was glued to his daily press conferences.
sentences.zh: 我个人记得当时我时刻关注着他的每日新闻发布会。

sentences.en: Good afternoon.
sentences.zh: 大家下午好。

sentences.en: Bigger group than usual.
sentences.zh: 今天人比平时多。

sentences.en: More than Maria.
sentences.zh: 比玛丽亚还多。

sentences.en: And I think a lot of people thought that his calm demeanor.
sentences.zh: 我想很多人都认为他那镇定的 demeanor（注：此处原文保持语感，译为“沉着镇定的风范”）。

sentences.en: New York, we make ourselves.
sentences.zh: 纽约，我们成就了自己。

sentences.en: His sense that we're all in this together.
sentences.zh: 他那种我们同舟共济的信念。

sentences.en: World War I, World War II, the Great
sentences.zh: 第一次世界大战、第二次世界大战、大

sentences.en: Depression.
sentences.zh: 萧条。

sentences.en: Some of the most tragic situations actually forged the character and the resolve of this nation.
sentences.zh: 一些最悲惨的境遇实际上塑造了这个国家的性格和决心。

sentences.en: New York State, the same thing.
sentences.zh: 纽约州也是如此。

sentences.en: And I'm going to be very fact-based.
sentences.zh: 我会非常基于事实。

sentences.en: I know, tell me the facts firSt. Then we'll do your opinion.
sentences.zh: 我知道，先告诉我事实，然后我们再讨论你的观点。

sentences.en: That resonated with a lot of people and I think provided a tremendous amount of calm in an otherwise chaotic and terrifying time.
sentences.zh: 这引发了许多人的共鸣，我认为在那个充满混乱和恐怖的时期，它极大地抚平了人心。

sentences.en: This is no time and no place for division.
sentences.zh: 现在不是分化的时候，也没有那个地方。

sentences.en: We have our hands full as it is.
sentences.zh: 我们本身就已经分身乏术了。

sentences.en: Let's just stay together and let's work it through.
sentences.zh: 让我们团结一致，共同渡过难关。

sentences.en: So he really emerged as a leader at the time and was granted emergency powers to make a lot of unilateral decisions for the entire state of New York.
sentences.zh: 所以他在当时确实作为领导者崭露头角，并被授予紧急权力，可以为整个纽约州做出许多单方面的决定。

sentences.en: And so how does he end up using those powers when it comes to the issue of overwhelmed hospitals and nursing homes?
sentences.zh: 那么，在面对医院和疗养院不堪重负的问题时，他是如何使用这些权力的呢？

sentences.en: You know, at the beginning, his health department in March issued this directive that said that COVID patients from hospitals had to
sentences.zh: 你知道的，一开始，他的卫生部门在3月份发布了一项指令，要求将医院里的新冠患者

sentences.en: be discharged to be discharged to nursing homes and nursing homes could not discriminate against COVID patients.
sentences.zh: 转出至疗养院，且疗养院不得歧视新冠患者。

sentences.en: Everyone knew that if COVID got into these populations where people are old and frail, it would be a disaster.
sentences.zh: 所有人都知道，如果新冠病毒进入这些老人和体弱者聚集的群体，将是一场灾难。

sentences.en: So a lot of nursing home operators really questioned this directive at the time and said this might potentially overwhelm the nursing home system.
sentences.zh: 因此，许多疗养院经营者当时对这项指令提出了质疑，并表示这可能会让疗养院系统不堪重负。

sentences.en: Why are you sending these positive patients into an institution in which there's a tremendous amount of danger?
sentences.zh: 你们为什么要将这些阳性患者送进一个存在巨大危险的机构里？

sentences.en: But nevertheless, the decision was made to mandate this.
sentences.zh: 但尽管如此，最终还是决定强制推行这一政策。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So at this particular time, nursing homes are being told you have to accept COVID patients.
sentences.zh: 所以在那个特定时期，疗养院被告知你们必须接收新冠患者。

sentences.en: Now, Cuomo later clarified in a press conference that nursing homes should not accept these patients if they couldn't safely care for them.
sentences.zh: 后来，库默在一次新闻发布会上澄清说，如果疗养院无法安全照顾这些患者，就不应接收他们。

sentences.en: But at the time, nursing homes viewed this as a mandate.
sentences.zh: 但在当时，疗养院将此视为一项强制命令。

sentences.en: And they're feeling really overwhelmed.
sentences.zh: 他们感到压力巨大。

sentences.en: Staff members are getting sick in nursing homes.
sentences.zh: 疗养院里的员工纷纷病倒。

sentences.en: And the industry is really feeling besieged.
sentences.zh: 整个行业都感到四面楚歌。

sentences.en: Also at this time, there is a sort of behind-the-scenes lobbying push by influential lobbying groups to the Cuomo administration to protect healthcare facilities
sentences.zh: 同样在这个时候，有影响力的游说集团在幕后向库默政府进行游说推进行动，要求在疫情期间保护医疗机构

sentences.en: from lawsuits during the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 免受诉讼。

sentences.en: They want this to extend to hospitals specifically.
sentences.zh: 他们希望这能专门延伸到医院。

sentences.en: Then the nursing home lobbying industry says, you know, we want those protections too.
sentences.zh: 然后疗养院游说行业说，你知道的，我们也想要这种保护。

sentences.en: Nursing homes have been so hard hit.
sentences.zh: 疗养院受到的打击太沉重了。

sentences.en: We don't have PPE.
sentences.zh: 我们没有个人防护装备。

sentences.en: We don't have the staffing.
sentences.zh: 我们没有足够的人手。

sentences.en: We want those protections as well.
sentences.zh: 我们也想要这种保护。

sentences.en: So in late March, aides to Governor Cuomo quietly insert this provision in the massive budget bill that protects both hospitals, healthcare facilities, and nursing homes
sentences.zh: 因此，在3月下旬，库默州长的助手们悄悄在庞大的预算法案中加入了这一条款，旨在保护医院、医疗机构和疗养院

sentences.en: from lawsuits over their handling of COVID cases.
sentences.zh: 免受因处理新冠病例而引发的诉讼。

sentences.en: And on April 2nd, the legislature approves this massive budget bill.
sentences.zh: 4月2日，立法机关批准了这项庞大的预算法案。

sentences.en: And most lawmakers don't notice that on page 347, in a seemingly unrelated piece of legislation,
sentences.zh: 大多数议员都没有注意到在第347页上，有一项看似无关的立法中，

sentences.en: there is these incredibly powerful protections for nursing homes that shield them from lawsuits.
sentences.zh: 包含着对疗养院极其强有力的保护措施，使其免受诉讼。

sentences.en: You said that most lawmakers don't notice, but somebody does eventually notice this provision.
sentences.zh: 你刚才说大多数议员都没有注意到，但最终还是有人注意到了这一条款。

sentences.en: There were a few advocates for nursing home residents who learned about these provisions and called reporters and told them about it.
sentences.zh: 有一些疗养院居民的维权人士了解到了这些条款，便打电话给记者并将此事告知了他们。

sentences.en: That was how I heard about this.
sentences.zh: 我就是这样听到这个消息的。

sentences.en: And then I started asking lawmakers who I thought would be aware of this about what their opinions were.
sentences.zh: 然后我开始询问那些我认为应该知道这件事的议员，了解他们的看法。

sentences.en: People like Richard Gottfried, the chairman of the Assembly's health committee.
sentences.zh: 比如理查德·戈特弗里德，他是州议会卫生委员会的主席。

sentences.en: But what I learned is that many of them said they were blindsided by these immunity provisions.
sentences.zh: 但我了解到的是，他们中的许多人表示对这些豁免条款感到完全始料未及。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 哼。

sentences.en: So you were telling them about what they had just voted to approve.
sentences.zh: 所以你是在告诉他们刚刚投票批准了什么。

sentences.en: Yeah, I was the one who was explaining to them what was in the budget bill.
sentences.zh: 对，我是那个向他们解释预算案里到底有什么内容的人。

sentences.en: And they were horrified because this was at the time that nursing home deaths were really starting to kind of trickle out.
sentences.zh: 他们感到惊恐万分，因为当时疗养院死亡人数正开始逐渐传出。

sentences.en: And we were just realizing how awful things were within nursing homes.
sentences.zh: 我们才刚刚意识到疗养院里面的情况有多么糟糕。

sentences.en: And then lawmakers realized that as we were hearing these reports of horrible negligence and deaths,
sentences.zh: 然后议员们意识到，当我们听到这些关于严重疏忽和死亡的报道时，

sentences.en: that they had actually approved these provisions to shield nursing homes from lawsuits.
sentences.zh: 他们实际上已经批准了这些旨在保护疗养院免受诉讼的条款。

sentences.en: You know, when I called Ron Kim, a Democratic Assemblyman in Queens, which was an area that was particularly ravaged with COVID cases,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，当我打电话给皇后区的民主党籍州议员罗恩·金时，那里的新冠疫情尤为肆虐，

sentences.en: he said that it was borderline criminal to include these legal provisions at a time where homes were not being transparent about what was going on inside
sentences.zh: 他说，在一个疗养院对内部情况不透明的时期，以及在亲属们甚至极度渴望获得亲人护理基本信息的时期，加入这些法律条款简直是近乎犯罪。

sentences.en: and at a time where family members were just desperate for even basic information about the care that their loved ones were getting.
sentences.zh: 那么，将这一条款写入预算案的库默政府，

sentences.en: Well, what would the Cuomo administration, which put this provision in the budget,
sentences.zh: 会如何为这些保护措施辩护呢？

sentences.en: say in defense of these protections?
sentences.zh: 或者换句话说，这些游说集团会怎么说？

sentences.en: And for that matter, what would these lobbying groups say?
sentences.zh: 因为最显而易见的解释似乎是，在这个公共卫生危机期间，州政府向医院和疗养院提出了很多要求，

sentences.en: Because it feels like the most obvious explanation would be that the state has asked a lot of hospitals and nursing homes during this public health crisis,
sentences.zh: 而他们只是在索取一些回报。

sentences.en: and they are just asking for something in return.
sentences.zh: 但事情远不止于此吗？

sentences.en: But is there more to it than that?
sentences.zh: 库默政府基本上将这些豁免保护比作“好撒玛利亚人法”。

sentences.en: The Cuomo administration basically likened these immunity protections to a good Samaritan law.
sentences.zh: 该法律的基本内容是，如果你处于紧急情况中，如果发生了事故，而你在紧急情况下试图帮助某人，

sentences.en: And what that says is basically, if you are in an emergency, if there's an accident and you're trying to help someone in an emergency,
sentences.zh: 那么你在试图提供帮助的过程中如果出了什么差错，不应承担责任。

sentences.en: you shouldn't be held responsible if something goes wrong as you're trying to provide help.
sentences.zh: 所以他们想表达的是，冠状病毒大流行的规模如此之广，以至于这对所有人来说都是一场紧急情况。

sentences.en: So what they were saying is that the scope of the coronavirus pandemic was so broad that this was an emergency for everyone.
sentences.zh: 保护医护人员的方式就是让他们免受诉讼。

sentences.en: The way that you protect healthcare workers is to shield them from lawsuits.
sentences.zh: 因此，库默政府的回应是，这不是为了保护一个糟糕的行业或糟糕的机构而做出什么邪恶的事情。

sentences.en: So the Cuomo administration's response is, you know, this was not anything nefarious to protect a bad industry or protect bad facilities.
sentences.zh: 这只是一种常识性的做法，旨在确保医疗系统能够顺利运转。

sentences.en: This was just kind of a common sense thing to do to ensure that the healthcare system is running smoothly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 从你的报道来看，艾米·朱莉娅，你对这种辩解有何看法？

sentences.en: And from your reporting, Amy Julia, what would you say to that defense?
sentences.zh: 这给你留下了什么印象？

sentences.en: How does it strike you?
sentences.zh: 这给你留下了什么样的印象？

sentences.en: So these immunity protections are treating all nursing homes as equal, of basically saying that this was an unprecedented crisis that was affecting all homes equally.
sentences.zh: 因此，这些豁免保护将所有养老院一视同仁，基本上声称这是一场前所未有的危机，对所有养老院的影响都是一样的。

sentences.en: What we know now is that that's not true.
sentences.zh: 而我们现在所知道的是，事实并非如此。

sentences.en: Homes that were underinvesting in staffing, homes that had been cited for not having enough staff members or not having infection control policies were hit with COVID much harder
sentences.zh: 那些在人员配备上投资不足的养老院，那些曾因员工不足或缺乏感染控制政策而被点名批评的养老院，受新冠疫情的打击要沉重得多

sentences.en: and the death toll was a lot more staggering.
sentences.zh: 死亡人数也更加惊人。

sentences.en: The people that I've talked to have said that these immunity protections are often protecting bad homes that were underinvesting in these things.
sentences.zh: 我交谈过的人都表示，这些豁免保护往往是在庇护那些在这些方面投资不足的糟糕养老院。

sentences.en: And it makes it very difficult for people to hold the homes accountable for poor care that could have saved their loved ones' lives.
sentences.zh: 这使得人们很难追究养老院因护理不善而导致其亲人丧生的责任。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一个专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you
sentences.zh: 甚至早在黑胶唱片时代的夜总会当DJ时，你每晚都要带着300件你最珍视的宝贝去工作

sentences.en: and you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你把一个DJ台变成了一个充满50年历史精美文物的快闪生活博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你喜爱的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费体验《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订户每天都能获取到什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是《纽约时报》的订户，请立即下载《时报》应用程序并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So, Amy Julia, it has been nearly a year since all of this played out.
sentences.zh: 所以，艾米·朱莉娅，这一切发生到现在已经快一年了。

sentences.en: New York as the epicenter of the pandemic, the situation inside the nursing homes, the protections that nursing homes were granted in the budget, and the outrage among lawmakers.
sentences.zh: 纽约作为疫情的震中，养老院内部的情况，预算中赋予养老院的保护措施，以及立法者们的愤怒。

sentences.en: So why are we talking about this now?
sentences.zh: 那么我们为什么现在要谈论这个？

sentences.en: For a while, it seemed like the Cuomo administration was sort of weathering the scandal around these nursing home policies.
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，库默政府似乎经受住了围绕这些养老院政策的丑闻。

sentences.en: And over the summer, they released a report that was tackling the nursing home issue, in which they said that the mandate for nursing homes to accept COVID-positive patients
sentences.zh: 在夏天的时候，他们发布了一份报告来处理养老院问题，他们在报告中称，要求养老院接收新冠检测呈阳性患者的政令

sentences.en: was not the cause of all of the death and carnage in nursing homes.
sentences.zh: 并不是导致养老院所有死亡和惨状的原因。

sentences.en: It was really asymptomatic workers who were sick.
sentences.zh: 真正的原因其实是生病的无症状工作人员。

sentences.en: Which means you could have walked into a nursing home, been totally conscientious, had no signs of anything, and walked it into a nursing home.
sentences.zh: 这意味着你可能走进一家养老院，极其负责任，没有任何症状，却把病毒带进了一家养老院。

sentences.en: But, you know, the Cuomo administration was continuing to get hammered on this, often from Republican lawmakers.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，库默政府一直在因此受到猛烈抨击，抨击往往来自共和党立法者。

sentences.en: And Cuomo's response to all of that criticism was, this is being weaponized by Republicans.
sentences.zh: 而库默对所有这些批评的回应是，这被共和党人武器化了。

sentences.en: And that was sort of the posturing, was that New York didn't do anything wrong.
sentences.zh: 当时的姿态大致就是，纽约没有做错任何事。

sentences.en: This is a political attack.
sentences.zh: 这是一场政治攻击。

sentences.en: It has no basis in fact.
sentences.zh: 它毫无事实依据。

sentences.en: It was pure politics, and it was ugly politics.
sentences.zh: 这是纯粹的政治，而且是丑陋的政治。

sentences.en: And now the report has the facts.
sentences.zh: 而现在报告有了事实。

sentences.en: And the facts tell the exact opposite story.
sentences.zh: 而事实讲述了一个截然相反的故事。

sentences.en: But the winds really shifted for the Cuomo administration this year in January, where New York's Attorney General Letitia James came out with a scathing bombshell report
sentences.zh: 但今年1月，库默政府的风向真的变了，当时纽约州总检察长莱蒂蒂亚·詹姆斯发表了一份极具杀伤力的重磅报告

sentences.en: that was really blasting the Cuomo administration for its handling of nursing home deaths.
sentences.zh: 这份报告严厉抨击了库默政府对养老院死亡人数的处理。

sentences.en: And what the report found was that nursing home deaths were severely undercounted in New York.
sentences.zh: 报告发现，纽约的养老院死亡人数被严重低估了。

sentences.en: They were only counting residents who had died in nursing homes, and not all of the nursing home residents who were sent to hospitals and then died.
sentences.zh: 他们只统计了在养老院内死亡的居民，而没有统计所有被送往医院随后死亡的养老院居民。

sentences.en: So the Cuomo administration was undercounting nursing home deaths by as much as 50 percent.
sentences.zh: 因此，库默政府将养老院死亡人数低估了高达50%。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Yeah, significant amount.
sentences.zh: 是的，数量相当庞大。

sentences.en: And the Attorney General is a Democrat, not a Republican.
sentences.zh: 而且总检察长是民主党人，不是共和党人。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So I think that carried a lot of political weight at the time when it came out.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得这在报告发布时具有很大的政治分量。

sentences.en: The AG report also tackled the very controversial March 25th mandate from the health department that nursing homes accept COVID-positive patients
sentences.zh: 总检察长报告还处理了卫生部3月25日那个极具争议的政令，即要求养老院接收新冠检测呈阳性的患者

sentences.en: and revealed that more than 6,000 patients from hospitals positive with COVID were sent to nursing homes.
sentences.zh: 并透露有6000多名来自医院的新冠阳性患者被送往养老院。

sentences.en: And that policy may have contributed to the high death count in New York.
sentences.zh: 而这项政策可能促成了纽约的高死亡人数。

sentences.en: So the AG report was really striking because you have this incredibly powerful Democrat saying that the Cuomo administration had made some questionable decisions
sentences.zh: 因此，总检察长报告确实令人震惊，因为一个极其强大的民主党人指出库默政府做出了一些可疑的决定

sentences.en: and that the death toll in nursing homes was much higher than we initially thought.
sentences.zh: 并且养老院的死亡人数远高于我们最初的想象。

sentences.en: And what does Governor Cuomo say about that once this report becomes public?
sentences.zh: 而一旦这份报告公之于众，库默州长对此怎么说？

sentences.en: He largely did not back down.
sentences.zh: 他基本上没有退缩。

sentences.en: If you look at New York State, we have a lower percentage of deaths in nursing homes than other states.
sentences.zh: 如果你看看纽约州，我们在养老院中的死亡率比其他州要低。

sentences.en: A third of all deaths in this nation are from nursing homes.
sentences.zh: 这个国家所有死亡人数的三分之一来自养老院。

sentences.en: New York State, we're only about 28 percent only.
sentences.zh: 纽约州，我们只占大约28%，仅仅而已。

sentences.en: And Cuomo essentially said it didn't matter where people died.
sentences.zh: 库默基本上表示，人们在哪里死并不重要。

sentences.en: But who cares?
sentences.zh: 谁在乎呢？

sentences.en: 33, 28, died in a hospital, died in a nursing home.
sentences.zh: 33，28，死在医院里，死在养老院里。

sentences.en: They died.
sentences.zh: 他们都死了。

sentences.en: That there were going to be deaths in nursing homes.
sentences.zh: 养老院里本来就会有人死亡。

sentences.en: So the exact location didn't really matter.
sentences.zh: 所以具体的地点其实并不重要。

sentences.en: Look, whether a person died in a hospital or died in a nursing home,
sentences.zh: 听着，无论一个人是死在医院里还是死在养老院里，

sentences.en: it's the people died.
sentences.zh: 关键是人死了。

sentences.en: But this was also happening at a time where new data was being released by the State Department of Health that showed the true toll of nursing home deaths.
sentences.zh: 但这也是在州卫生部门发布新数据的时候发生的，这些数据展示了养老院死亡人数的真实规模。

sentences.en: And they said that there had been more than 15,000 residents of nursing homes and long-term care facilities who had died, which was dramatically more than had been reported.
sentences.zh: 他们表示，已有超过15000名养老院和长期护理机构的居民死亡，这比之前报告的数字要多得多。

sentences.en: That was a crisis for the Cuomo administration.
sentences.zh: 这对库默政府来说是一场危机。

sentences.en: And as this is all happening, lawmakers are really calling out the administration for their handling of this and the lack of transparency.
sentences.zh: 正当这一切发生时，立法者们纷纷痛斥政府对这一事件的处理方式以及缺乏透明度。

sentences.en: There is this New York Post report that revealed that one of Governor Cuomo's top aides admitted to lawmakers that they had not been transparent
sentences.zh: 有一篇《纽约邮报》的报道透露，库默州长的一位高级助手曾向立法者承认，他们一直不够透明

sentences.en: and had been withholding the true nursing home death count because they were worried that it would be politicized by the Trump Department of Justice,
sentences.zh: 并且一直在隐瞒真实的养老院死亡人数，因为他们担心这会被特朗普的司法部政治化

sentences.en: which was looking into New York's handling of coronavirus cases in nursing homes.
sentences.zh: 当时特朗普司法部正在调查纽约对养老院冠状病毒病例的处理情况。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The aide herself says this.
sentences.zh: 助手本人就是这么说的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And that puts the Cuomo administration even more on the defensive.
sentences.zh: 这让库默政府更加处于守势。

sentences.en: Happy Day 352.
sentences.zh: 祝第352天快乐。

sentences.en: Happy President's Day again.
sentences.zh: 再次祝总统日快乐。

sentences.en: And last week in a news conference, Cuomo, who rarely backs down from any policy decision, issued kind of a rare, almost apology.
sentences.zh: 而在上周的新闻发布会上，很少在任何政策决定上退缩的库默，罕见地发表了一种近乎道歉的言论。

sentences.en: Apologize?
sentences.zh: 道歉？

sentences.en: Look, I have said repeatedly, we made a mistake in creating the void.
sentences.zh: 听着，我多次说过，我们在制造信息真空上犯了错误。

sentences.en: We made a mistake in creating the void.
sentences.zh: 我们在制造信息真空上犯了错误。

sentences.en: When we didn't provide information, it allowed press, people, cynics, politicians to fill the void.
sentences.zh: 当我们不提供信息时，它就让媒体、民众、愤世嫉俗者、政客们去填补了真空。

sentences.en: He never officially apologized, but he came the closest that he had to saying that it was a mistake to withhold some of this data.
sentences.zh: 他从未正式道歉，但这已经是他最接近于承认隐瞒部分数据是一个错误的时候了。

sentences.en: Total death counts were always accurate.
sentences.zh: 总死亡人数一直是准确的。

sentences.en: Nothing was hidden from anyone.
sentences.zh: 没有什么对任何人隐瞒的。

sentences.en: But we did create the void, and that created pain.
sentences.zh: 但我们确实制造了真空，这带来了痛苦。

sentences.en: And I feel very badly about that.
sentences.zh: 对此我感到非常难过。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Thank you all very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢大家。

sentences.en: And I imagine for someone like Governor Cuomo, any admission like this was pretty hard to get to.
sentences.zh: 我想对于像库默州长这样的人来说，要做出任何这样的承认都是相当艰难的。

sentences.en: This is not a man known for acknowledging mistakes of any kind.
sentences.zh: 他可不是一个以承认任何错误而闻名的人。

sentences.en: So I think it tells you something about the situation that he's in.
sentences.zh: 所以我想这说明了他所处境地的某些问题。

sentences.en: This has morphed into a full political firestorm for Andrew Cuomo.
sentences.zh: 这对安德鲁·库默来说已经演变成了一场全面的政治风暴。

sentences.en: Lawmakers who before had often been scared to speak up against the governor are coming out.
sentences.zh: 以前经常不敢大声反对州长的立法者们现在都站出来了。

sentences.en: Welcome to the show, sir.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到节目，先生。

sentences.en: Very nice to have you here today.
sentences.zh: 很高兴今天你能来到这里。

sentences.en: And really holding him accountable for his way of responding to the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 并且切实追究他在应对大流行病方式上的责任。

sentences.en: Yeah, so it was last Thursday night.
sentences.zh: 是的，那是上周四晚上。

sentences.en: I was about to bathe my three kids when I received the call from the governor.
sentences.zh: 我正准备给我的三个孩子洗澡，这时我接到了州长的电话。

sentences.en: Ron Kim, who had been the lawmaker who was outraged over the immunity provisions, came out and said that...
sentences.zh: 罗恩·金，这位曾对豁免条款感到愤怒的立法者，站出来说...

sentences.en: He spent 10 minutes threatening my career and ordering me to issue a statement that would be used to cover for the state secretary.
sentences.zh: 他花了10分钟威胁我的职业生涯，并命令我发表一份声明，用来为州秘书做掩护。

sentences.en: Governor Cuomo had called him, yelled at him for 10 minutes and said,
sentences.zh: 库默州长给他打了电话，对大吼了10分钟并说，

sentences.en: I will destroy you after Ron Kim had really been vocal in holding the Cuomo administration accountable for the carnage in nursing homes.
sentences.zh: 我要毁了你。在此之前，罗恩·金一直在大声疾呼，要追究库默政府对养老院惨状的责任。

sentences.en: We could have done our jobs.
sentences.zh: 我们本可以做好我们的工作。

sentences.en: We could have legislated.
sentences.zh: 我们本可以进行立法。

sentences.en: And he took that away from us.
sentences.zh: 而他把这从我们手中夺走了。

sentences.en: We could have had a different outcome if we had all the information in real time.
sentences.zh: 如果我们能实时掌握所有信息，我们本可以有不同的结果。

sentences.en: There's also a federal inquiry into the Cuomo administration's handling of this nursing home issue.
sentences.zh: 联邦还在对库默政府处理这个养老院问题进行调查。

sentences.en: The FBI and the U.S.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局和美国

sentences.en: Attorney's Office are investigating this.
sentences.zh: 总检察长办公室正在对此进行调查。

sentences.en: And lawmakers are moving to strip Cuomo of the emergency powers they granted him at the beginning of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 立法者正采取行动剥夺库默在大流行病初期赋予他的紧急权力。

sentences.en: Partially as a result of this fallout from the nursing home scandal.
sentences.zh: 部分原因正是养老院丑闻带来的这一余波。

sentences.en: It's striking that the very thing that causes Cuomo, if we think back to the beginning of the pandemic, to rise to national fame,
sentences.zh: 令人瞩目的是，正是那件让库默——如果我们回想大流行病初期的话——声名鹊起的事，

sentences.en: this unilateral approach to decision making and his message that kind of he and he alone was in charge of New York's response,
sentences.zh: 这种单边决策的方法以及他传达的似乎只有他一个人在掌控纽约应对疫情的信息，

sentences.en: is ultimately what seems to be now calling his entire handling of this into so much question and, given what you just described, may end up costing him real power.
sentences.zh: 最终似乎成了现在让人们对他处理这一切的方式产生如此多质疑的原因，并且，鉴于你刚才所描述的，最终可能会让他失去真正的权力。

sentences.en: Yeah, I remember it was pretty striking at the beginning of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 是的，我记得在大流行病初期这相当引人注目。

sentences.en: He said, if there's blame, blame me.
sentences.zh: 他说，如果有责，就把责任归咎于我。

sentences.en: And now as we're emerging almost a year later, I think a lot of blame is falling on his shoulders.
sentences.zh: 而现在，当我们将近一年后走出来时，我认为很多指责都落在了他的肩上。

sentences.en: And I think one of the things that did him no favor was any time that his administration was under fire for the way that they had responded to either the directive to accept COVID patients or undercounting deaths.
sentences.zh: 我认为没有对他的政治生涯起一点帮助的事情是，每当他的政府因应对接收新冠患者的指令或低估死亡人数的方式而受到抨击时，

sentences.en: He always refused to acknowledge fault in his administration's handling of the crisis at an admittedly very difficult time.
sentences.zh: 在公认非常困难的时期，他总是拒绝承认其政府在处理危机时存在过失。

sentences.en: I think that strident defense of, I did nothing wrong, really rubbed a lot of people the wrong way, in particular, family members of nursing home residents.
sentences.zh: 我认为这种“我没有做错任何事”的强硬辩护，确实让很多人感到反感，尤其是养老院居民的家属。

sentences.en: And I talked to Lori about this, who said that, you know, at the beginning, she was a Cuomo fan.
sentences.zh: 我为此和洛里交谈过，她说，你知道，一开始她是库默的粉丝。

sentences.en: She was glued to his press conferences and found them really reassuring.
sentences.zh: 她紧盯着他的新闻发布会，并觉得它们真的很令人安心。

sentences.en: But as time went on, and she saw what happened in nursing homes and just heard him dismiss her pain of not having answers, she said she really felt betrayed.
sentences.zh: 但随着时间的推移，当她看到养老院发生的事情，并听到他对她因得不到答案而感到的痛苦不屑一顾时，她说她真的感到被背叛了。

sentences.en: It was the insistence that the response was perfect,
sentences.zh: 正是这种坚称应对措施完美无缺的傲慢，

sentences.en: that there were very few mistakes that really led her and so many other people to be so angry with the Cuomo administration's response.
sentences.zh: 以及几乎没有什么错误的说辞，才真正导致她和许多其他人对库默政府的应对措施感到如此愤怒。

sentences.en: Amy Julia, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 艾米·朱莉娅，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Amy Julia, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 艾米·朱莉娅，非常感谢。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们不胜感激。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: Lori, I'm wondering how you're reflecting on all of this, because it's been nearly a year since you lost your mom.
sentences.zh: 洛里，我想知道你是如何回顾这一切的，因为你失去母亲已经快一年了。

sentences.en: She was one of the first people who died in the first wave that hit New York so hard.
sentences.zh: 她是第一波沉重打击纽约的疫情中最早去世的人之一。

sentences.en: And now there are just hundreds of thousands of Americans all over who have died of COVID.
sentences.zh: 而现在，到处都有成千上万的美国人死于新冠。

sentences.en: How are you thinking about things now?
sentences.zh: 你现在是怎么看待这些事情的？

sentences.en: I'm not thinking any differently than I was when my mother first died.
sentences.zh: 我的想法和我母亲刚去世时没有任何不同。

sentences.en: I just don't understand it.
sentences.zh: 我只是不明白。

sentences.en: There's no answer.
sentences.zh: 根本没有答案。

sentences.en: How can you feel any different when you're still in the same spot?
sentences.zh: 当你依然停留在同一个地方时，你怎么可能会有不同的感觉？

sentences.en: We don't have any more clarity to make us feel any different.
sentences.zh: 我们没有任何更多的清晰度来让我们有不同的感受。

sentences.en: There's still not a night that you don't go to bed and think about how they died or whatever, because we don't have the answers, because the story never changed.
sentences.zh: 依然没有哪个夜晚你上床睡觉时不会去想他们是怎么死的或其他什么，因为我们没有答案，因为故事从来没有变过。

sentences.en: The story is still the same.
sentences.zh: 故事依然是一样的。

sentences.en: We don't know why things happen the way they happen.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道事情为什么会以它们发生的方式发生。

sentences.en: So how does the story end?
sentences.zh: 所以这个故事将如何结束？

sentences.en: It doesn't end.
sentences.zh: 它不会结束。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: It can't end.
sentences.zh: 它无法结束。

sentences.en: There is no end because they're not giving us an ending.
sentences.zh: 没有结局，因为他们没有给我们一个结局。

sentences.en: Since the start of the pandemic, about a dozen states have told nursing homes to admit patients with COVID-19.
sentences.zh: 自大流行病开始以来，大约有十个州指示养老院接收新冠患者。

sentences.en: And 36 states have taken steps to protect nursing homes and their staff from lawsuits.
sentences.zh: 而有36个州采取了措施，保护养老院及其员工免受诉讼。

sentences.en: In all, more than 160,000 residents and staff of nursing homes and long-term care facilities have been killed by the virus.
sentences.zh: 总计有超过16万名疗养院和长期护理机构的居民及员工死于这种病毒。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, in a closely watched case, a grand jury decided not to bring charges against police officers in Rochester, New York,
sentences.zh: 周二，在一个备受瞩目的案件中，大陪审团决定不对纽约州罗切斯特的警官提起指控，

sentences.en: for their wall in the death of Daniel Prude, a 41-year-old Black man.
sentences.zh: 起因是他们在41岁黑人男子丹尼尔·普鲁d之死中所扮演的角色。

sentences.en: Prude died last year after officers placed a mesh hood on his head and pressed his face into the pavement until he lost consciousness and later died.
sentences.zh: 普鲁去年去世，此前警官们将一个网状头罩套在他的头上，并把他的脸按在人行道上，直到他失去知觉并最终死亡。

sentences.en: His death led to weeks of protest in Rochester.
sentences.zh: 他的死引发了罗切斯特长达数周的抗议。

sentences.en: I know that the Prude family, the Rochester community, and communities across the country will rightfully be disappointed by this outcome.
sentences.zh: 我知道普鲁的家人、罗切斯特社区以及全国各地的社区会对这个结果感到失望，这是合情合理的。

sentences.en: During a news conference on Tuesday, New York's Attorney General, Letitia James, expressed frustration with the grand jury's decision.
sentences.zh: 在周二的新闻发布会上，纽约州总检察长莱蒂蒂亚·詹姆斯对大陪审团的决定表示了沮丧。

sentences.en: My office presented an extensive case,
sentences.zh: 我的办公室提交了一个详尽的案件，

sentences.en: and we sought a different outcome than the one the grand jury handed us today.
sentences.zh: 并且我们争取的是一个与大陪审团今天给我们的不同的结果。

sentences.en: And two new studies have found that a variant of the coronavirus discovered in California is more contagious than earlier forms of the virus,
sentences.zh: 两项新的研究发现，在加利福尼亚州发现的一种新冠病毒变种比该病毒的早期形态更具传染性，

sentences.en: with one study finding that the variant produces twice as many viral particles in the body as other variants.
sentences.zh: 其中一项研究发现，该变种在体内产生的病毒颗粒是其他变种的两倍。

sentences.en: The Times reports that the variant, which has already spread quickly in San Francisco,
sentences.zh: 据《纽约时报》报道，这种已经在旧金山迅速传播的变种，

sentences.en: could threaten the steady declines in new infections that has occurred across California in recent weeks.
sentences.zh: 可能会威胁到加州各地近几周出现的新感染病例稳步下降的趋势。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Jessica Chung, with help from Luke Vanderplug and Nina Pawtuck.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由杰西卡·钟制作，卢克·范德普鲁格和尼娜·帕特克提供了帮助。

sentences.en: It was edited by Lisa Tobin, Michael Benoit, and Anita Bonnageau, and engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 节目由丽莎·托宾、迈克尔·贝努瓦和安妮塔·博纳焦编辑，克里斯·伍德担任音频工程。

sentences.en: Special thanks to Jesse McKinley.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢杰西·麦金利。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是今天的《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了许多自称为改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱且有时令人兴奋的争斗之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在由我萨拉·科尼格主持的最新一期《都市》节目中，讲述了人们试图维持其影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在各大播客平台收听。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。
